blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 HVAC 設備安裝與啟動（Installation & Startup）各組件的關鍵檢查要點：AHU、風扇、盤管、加濕器、除濕器、HEPA 濾網、風管等
blocks.en: Understand the key inspection points for each HVAC component during installation and startup: AHUs, fans, coils, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, HEPA filters, ductwork, etc.

blocks.zh: 理解 Commissioning（調試）與 Qualification（確效）的差異，以及 V-Model 在 HVAC 系統中的應用
blocks.en: Understand the difference between commissioning and qualification, and how the V-model applies to HVAC systems

blocks.zh: 了解潔淨室粒子計數、恢復測試、壓差驗證與壓差報警延遲測試的執行方法
blocks.en: Learn how to perform cleanroom particle counts, recovery tests, pressure differential verification and pressure alarm delay tests

blocks.zh: 熟悉 HVAC 系統人員培訓的範圍與內容要求
blocks.en: Be familiar with the scope and content requirements of HVAC system personnel training

blocks.zh: 掌握各類 HVAC 設備的預防性維護（PM）與預測性維護（PdM）策略，包括維護頻率建議
blocks.en: Understand preventive maintenance (PM) and predictive maintenance (PdM) strategies for the various types of HVAC equipment, including recommended maintenance frequencies

blocks.zh: 理解備品管理（Spare Parts）策略，確保關鍵組件故障時能快速復原
blocks.en: Understand spare parts strategy, so that critical components can be restored quickly when they fail

blocks.zh: 5.2 (cont.) Specifying and Testing HEPA Filters（HEPA 濾網規格與測試）
blocks.en: 5.2 (cont.) Specifying and Testing HEPA Filters

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Bleed-through（穿透洩漏）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Bleed-through

blocks.zh: Bleed-through（穿透洩漏）：HEPA 濾網在高風速下，原本被攔截的微粒被「吹穿」濾材，導致過濾效率下降。這不是濾網破損，而是物理上的效率衰減。
blocks.en: Bleed-through: At high air velocities, particles that would normally be captured are "blown through" the HEPA filter media, reducing filtration efficiency. This is not a damaged filter; it is a physical loss of efficiency.

blocks.zh: MPPS（Most Penetrating Particle Size，最大穿透粒徑）：通常在 0.1~0.3 微米之間，是 HEPA 濾網效率最低的粒徑範圍。工廠測試必須在此粒徑下進行才有意義。
blocks.en: MPPS (Most Penetrating Particle Size): Typically between 0.1 and 0.3 µm, this is the particle size range at which a HEPA filter is least efficient. Factory testing is only meaningful if performed at this particle size.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：局部穿透限值
blocks.en: Key Point: Local Penetration Limit

blocks.zh: 如果現場使用 hot-block generator 做完整性測試，要求比 EN-1822 標準更嚴格：局部穿透限值從 5 倍全球穿透（0.025%）收緊到 2 倍（0.01%）。這是因為 hot-block 產生的氣溶膠粒徑分布與 DOP/PAO 不同，需要更嚴格的規格來確保等效的安全水準。
blocks.en: If a hot-block generator is used for on-site integrity testing, the requirement is stricter than the EN-1822 standard: the local penetration limit is tightened from 5 times the global penetration (0.025%) to 2 times (0.01%). This is because the aerosol particle size distribution produced by a hot-block generator differs from DOP/PAO, so a tighter specification is needed to ensure an equivalent level of safety.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一個魚網——在水流緩慢時可以攔住所有魚，但如果水流太急，部分小魚就會被沖穿過去。HEPA 濾網的 bleed-through 就是這個原理：風速越高，微粒越容易穿透。所以濾網必須在「實際最大風速」下測試，而不是在理想低速下測。
blocks.en: Imagine a fishing net: when the water flows slowly it catches every fish, but if the current is too fast, some of the small fish are swept through. HEPA filter bleed-through works on the same principle: the higher the air velocity, the more easily particles penetrate. That is why a filter must be tested at the actual maximum air velocity, not at an ideal low velocity.

blocks.zh: 5.3 Equipment Installation and Startup（設備安裝與啟動）
blocks.en: 5.3 Equipment Installation and Startup

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Build Clean（潔淨施工）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Build Clean

blocks.zh: Build Clean（潔淨施工）：在施工階段就開始控制潔淨度——安裝前清潔組件、安裝後清潔系統、密封已完工的風管防止污染進入。這個概念的重要性在於：施工階段的髒污會「嵌入」系統中，開機後很難完全清除。
blocks.en: Build Clean: Control cleanliness from the construction phase onward: clean components before installation, clean the system after installation, and seal completed ductwork to keep contamination out. This matters because dirt left during construction becomes "embedded" in the system and is very hard to remove completely after startup.

blocks.zh: White Glove Test（白手套測試）：用白手套擦拭風管內壁，檢查是否有灰塵殘留。雖然可能不會正式寫入規格，但 ISPE 期望系統品質要能「通過」這個測試。
blocks.en: White Glove Test: Wipe the inside wall of the duct with a white glove and check for dust residue. Although it may not be formally written into the specification, ISPE expects system quality to be good enough to "pass" this test.

blocks.zh: 就像裝潢新房子——如果在油漆、鋪地板之前沒有把建築粉塵清乾淨，那些灰塵就會永遠藏在牆壁和地板之間。HVAC 系統也一樣：施工期間的金屬碎屑、油脂、灰塵如果沒有清除，開機後就會被吹入潔淨室，甚至刺穿 HEPA 濾網。
blocks.en: It is like renovating a new house: if the construction dust is not cleaned up before painting and laying floors, it stays hidden between the walls and floors forever. The same is true of an HVAC system: metal shavings, grease and dust left over from construction will be blown into the cleanroom after startup, and can even puncture the HEPA filters.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: Practical Application for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，工廠在改建或擴廠時，HVAC 系統的 build clean 執行力度直接影響後續確效的順利程度。建議：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, how rigorously build clean is carried out during a facility renovation or expansion directly affects how smoothly later qualification goes. Recommendations:

blocks.zh: 將 build clean 要求寫入施工合約，明訂驗收標準
blocks.en: Write build clean requirements into the construction contract, with clearly defined acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 每日施工結束時進行區域清潔檢查
blocks.en: Carry out an area cleanliness inspection at the end of each construction day

blocks.zh: HVAC 風管完成後立即密封，設專人巡視
blocks.en: Seal HVAC ductwork immediately after completion and assign a dedicated person to patrol it

blocks.zh: 準備上述工具清單中的基本量測設備，培養內部 HVAC 工程師的問題排解能力
blocks.en: Prepare the basic measuring equipment from the tool list above, and build the troubleshooting skills of in-house HVAC engineers

blocks.zh: 5.3.2 Air Handling Units Shipping, Storage, Installation（AHU 運輸、儲存與安裝）
blocks.en: 5.3.2 Air Handling Units Shipping, Storage, Installation

blocks.zh: 重點提示：閒置設備的軸承保護
blocks.en: Key Point: Bearing Protection for Idle Equipment

blocks.zh: 這是一個容易被忽略但代價高昂的細節：AHU 閒置超過一個月，軸承就可能因為潤滑油重力沉降導致乾磨損。每兩週手動轉動軸承是最簡單的預防措施。在專案施工延遲的情況下，這一點特別重要——設備到場後等待數月才安裝的情況屢見不鮮。
blocks.en: This detail is easy to overlook but costly: if an AHU sits idle for more than a month, the bearings can suffer dry wear because the lubricant settles under gravity. Manually rotating the bearings every two weeks is the simplest preventive measure. This is especially important when projects are delayed, since equipment that arrives on site and then waits months for installation is far from unusual.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：AHU 安裝五大要點
blocks.en: Key Concept: Five Key Points of AHU Installation

blocks.zh: 吊裝：使用吊耳支架垂直水平起吊，防止變形。必須由有經驗的吊裝師傅監督
blocks.en: Lifting: Lift vertically and level using lifting lugs and brackets to prevent deformation. Lifting must be supervised by an experienced rigger.

blocks.zh: 基礎：剛性水平基座，確保風扇對中、減少振動、排水順暢
blocks.en: Foundation: A rigid, level base ensures fan alignment, reduces vibration and allows smooth drainage.

blocks.zh: P-trap 高度：凝結水排水 P-trap 必須足夠高，防止運轉時空氣反吸
blocks.en: P-trap height: The condensate drain P-trap must be tall enough to prevent air from being drawn back in during operation.

blocks.zh: 密封：組裝段與段之間用墊片 + RTV 密封膠，膠量要少、表面要平滑
blocks.en: Sealing: Use gaskets plus RTV sealant between sections; use as little sealant as possible and keep the surface smooth.

blocks.zh: VFD 啟動：從低轉速慢慢加速，邊聽邊看邊摸（聽噪音、看振動、摸軸承溫度）
blocks.en: VFD startup: Ramp up slowly from low speed, and listen, look and feel as you go (listen for noise, look for vibration, feel the bearing temperature).

blocks.zh: AHU 安裝就像組裝一台精密的大型引擎：每個螺絲的鬆緊度、每個密封面的平整度、每個軸承的潤滑狀態都會影響最終性能。就像新車磨合期要慢速行駛一樣，VFD 驅動的 AHU 也要從低速「磨合」開始，逐步提速到設計轉速。
blocks.en: Installing an AHU is like assembling a large, precision engine: the tightness of every bolt, the flatness of every sealing surface and the lubrication of every bearing all affect final performance. Just as a new car needs to be driven slowly during its break-in period, a VFD-driven AHU should also be "run in" from low speed and gradually brought up to design speed.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的工廠在 AHU 到貨後、安裝前的儲存期間，是否有執行軸承定期轉動的程序？
blocks.en: Does your facility have a procedure for periodically rotating the bearings while an AHU is stored after delivery and before installation?

blocks.zh: AHU 啟動前的檢查清單是否包含洩漏測試和凝結水排放測試？
blocks.en: Does the pre-startup checklist for AHUs include leak testing and condensate drain testing?

blocks.zh: 5.3.3 - 5.3.5 Fans, Coils & Humidifiers Installation（風扇、盤管與加濕器安裝）
blocks.en: 5.3.3 - 5.3.5 Fans, Coils & Humidifiers Installation

blocks.zh: 重點提示：風扇安裝的安全警告
blocks.en: Key Point: Safety Warnings for Fan Installation

blocks.zh: ISPE 用了「catastrophic（災難性）」和「life threatening（危及生命）」這樣的字眼——這在整本指南中非常罕見。風扇轉動時產生的動能極大，如果安裝不當（葉輪不平衡、軸承未對準、皮帶張力不對），可能造成葉片飛出、軸承爆裂等嚴重事故。
blocks.en: ISPE uses words such as "catastrophic" and "life threatening", which is very rare in this guide. A rotating fan carries a great deal of kinetic energy, and if it is installed improperly (unbalanced impeller, misaligned bearings, incorrect belt tension), it can cause serious accidents such as blades flying off or bearings bursting.

blocks.zh: 雷射對中：出廠對中在運輸後會位移，現場必須重新做
blocks.en: Laser alignment: Factory alignment shifts during transport and must be redone on site.

blocks.zh: 皮帶張力：啟動前調好，24 小時後必須重新調整（新皮帶會伸長）
blocks.en: Belt tension: Adjust before startup, and readjust after 24 hours (new belts stretch).

blocks.zh: 點動測試：先用手轉確認不碰殼，再電動點動確認旋轉方向
blocks.en: Bump (jog) test: First turn by hand to confirm there is no contact with the housing, then jog electrically to confirm the direction of rotation.

blocks.zh: 臨界轉速：確認運轉轉速遠離共振點
blocks.en: Critical speed: Confirm that the operating speed is well away from resonance points.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Moisture Carry-over（水滴攜帶）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Moisture Carry-over

blocks.zh: Moisture Carry-over（水滴攜帶）：冷卻盤管表面的凝結水被氣流吹離，隨空氣進入下游設備和風管。這會導致：風管內壁生鏽、微生物滋生、HEPA 濾網受潮。三種解決方案按優先順序：降低面速度 > 安裝擋水板 > 安裝除霧器。
blocks.en: Moisture Carry-over: Condensate on the cooling coil surface is blown off by the airflow and carried with the air into downstream equipment and ductwork. This leads to rust on the duct walls, microbial growth and wetting of the HEPA filters. There are three solutions, in order of priority: reduce the face velocity > install drain eliminators (baffles) > install mist eliminators.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：蒸汽加濕器位置禁忌
blocks.en: Key Point: Where Not to Place a Steam Humidifier

blocks.zh: 蒸汽分配歧管的放置位置有三個「不可以」：
blocks.en: There are three "do nots" for the location of the steam distribution manifold:

blocks.zh: 不可靠近濾網：蒸汽飽和會大幅縮短濾網壽命
blocks.en: Not near filters: Steam saturation greatly shortens filter life.

blocks.zh: 不可對著金屬面：可見蒸汽直接衝擊金屬表面會造成腐蝕
blocks.en: Not facing metal surfaces: Visible steam impinging directly on metal surfaces causes corrosion.

blocks.zh: 不可在溫度不足的位置：空氣溫度不夠高時無法完全吸收蒸汽，造成凝結
blocks.en: Not where the temperature is insufficient: If the air is not warm enough, it cannot fully absorb the steam, and condensation results.

blocks.zh: 另外，風管內安裝加濕器時，下游風管必須用不鏽鋼——因為蒸汽未完全吸收前會持續凝結。
blocks.en: In addition, when a humidifier is installed inside a duct, the downstream ductwork must be stainless steel, because the steam continues to condense until it is fully absorbed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務提醒
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Reminder

blocks.zh: 台灣氣候高溫高濕，蒸汽加濕器主要用於冬季和乾季。但冷卻盤管的 moisture carry-over 在全年都是潛在問題。建議在 AHU 啟動後的第一個夏季高溫期，專門觀察是否有水滴攜帶現象，並在 PM 記錄中列為檢查項目。
blocks.en: Taiwan's climate is hot and humid, so steam humidifiers are mainly used in winter and the dry season. However, moisture carry-over from cooling coils is a potential problem all year round. It is recommended to watch specifically for moisture carry-over during the first hot summer period after the AHU is started up, and to make it an inspection item in the PM records.

blocks.zh: 5.3.6 - 5.3.8 Desiccant Dehumidifiers, Air Filtration & Ductwork（除濕器、空氣過濾與風管）
blocks.en: 5.3.6 - 5.3.8 Desiccant Dehumidifiers, Air Filtration & Ductwork

blocks.zh: 重點提示：LiCl 乾燥劑輪的特殊要求
blocks.en: Key Point: Special Requirements for LiCl Desiccant Wheels

blocks.zh: 氯化鋰（Lithium Chloride）乾燥劑有一個致命弱點：如果停機時放著不管，它會過度吸收環境水分，膨脹後從輪子上「爆裂」出來。所以即使不需要除濕，LiCl 輪也必須保持加熱和轉動。這是一個「不用也不能停」的設備。
blocks.en: Lithium chloride desiccant has a fatal weakness: if it is left alone when shut down, it absorbs too much moisture from the environment, swells and "bursts" off the wheel. So even when dehumidification is not needed, a LiCl wheel must be kept heated and rotating. It is a piece of equipment that cannot be stopped even when it is not in use.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HEPA 濾網的處置鏈
blocks.en: Key Concept: The HEPA Filter Handling Chain

blocks.zh: ISPE 對 HEPA 濾網的處置要求涵蓋整個「供應鏈」：
blocks.en: ISPE's requirements for handling HEPA filters cover the entire "supply chain":

blocks.zh: 運輸：選擇適當的運送方式和載具，到貨逐批檢查
blocks.en: Transport: Choose an appropriate shipping method and vehicle, and inspect every shipment on arrival.

blocks.zh: 收貨：損壞的棧板不可接受，必須註記在運送文件上
blocks.en: Receipt: Damaged pallets are not acceptable and must be noted on the delivery documents.

blocks.zh: 儲存：室內、有屋頂、4~38°C、25~75% RH
blocks.en: Storage: Indoors, under a roof, 4-38°C, 25-75% RH.

blocks.zh: 安裝前：檢查濾網外殼和安裝框架的潔淨度
blocks.en: Before installation: Check the cleanliness of the filter housing and mounting frame.

blocks.zh: 安裝時：避免損傷濾材，確認夾持機構無旁通
blocks.en: During installation: Avoid damaging the filter media, and confirm that the clamping mechanism has no bypass.

blocks.zh: 任何一個環節的疏忽，都可能讓一個幾萬元的 HEPA 濾網還沒啟用就報廢。
blocks.en: Negligence at any one step can scrap a HEPA filter worth tens of thousands of NT dollars before it is ever put into service.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：風管金屬碎屑的連鎖反應
blocks.en: Key Point: The Knock-on Effect of Metal Debris in Ductwork

blocks.zh: 這是一個被低估的風險：風管施工後期安裝感測器、偵煙器時，鑽孔產生的金屬碎屑留在風管內，系統啟動後被吹向 HEPA 濾網，尖銳的金屬碎片刺穿濾材，導致完整性測試失敗。
blocks.en: This is an underestimated risk: when sensors and smoke detectors are installed late in duct construction, the metal shavings from drilling stay inside the duct. After system startup they are blown toward the HEPA filters, and sharp metal fragments puncture the filter media, causing the integrity test to fail.

blocks.zh: 預防措施：用 self-piercing (zip) screws 取代 self-drilling screws。後期開孔時必須清潔風管內部。風管清潔後立即用塑膠膜封口。
blocks.en: Preventive measures: Use self-piercing (zip) screws instead of self-drilling screws. Clean the inside of the duct whenever holes are made late in construction. Seal the duct with plastic sheeting immediately after cleaning.

blocks.zh: 你的 HEPA 濾網供應商是否有明確的運輸和儲存要求？收貨檢查程序是否涵蓋包裝完整性？
blocks.en: Does your HEPA filter supplier have clear transport and storage requirements? Does the receiving inspection procedure cover packaging integrity?

blocks.zh: 風管施工規範中是否禁止使用 self-drilling screws？是否要求後期開孔後清潔風管？
blocks.en: Do your ductwork construction specifications prohibit self-drilling screws? Do they require the duct to be cleaned after late-stage hole drilling?

blocks.zh: 施工期間是否安裝臨時過濾器保護 AHU 和風管系統？
blocks.en: Are temporary filters installed during construction to protect the AHU and ductwork?

blocks.zh: 5.3.8.1 Duct Leakage Test（風管洩漏測試）
blocks.en: 5.3.8.1 Duct Leakage Test

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風管洩漏的影響層次
blocks.en: Key Concept: Layers of Impact from Duct Leakage

blocks.zh: 風管洩漏不只是「漏風」那麼簡單，它會造成連鎖效應：
blocks.en: Duct leakage is more than simply "air leaking out"; it causes a chain of effects:

blocks.zh: 風量不足：下游房間得不到設計風量，換氣次數降低
blocks.en: Insufficient airflow: Downstream rooms do not receive the design airflow, and air change rates fall.

blocks.zh: 壓差失控：漏風改變了系統的壓力平衡
blocks.en: Loss of pressure control: Leakage changes the pressure balance of the system.

blocks.zh: 能耗增加：風扇必須更用力補償洩漏量
blocks.en: Higher energy consumption: The fan has to work harder to compensate for the leakage.

blocks.zh: 容量耗盡：系統在全負載運轉，沒有儲備容量
blocks.en: Exhausted capacity: The system runs at full load with no reserve capacity.

blocks.zh: 交叉污染風險：正壓風管漏入機房，或機房空氣漏入負壓風管
blocks.en: Cross-contamination risk: Air from positive-pressure ducts leaks into the mechanical room, or mechanical room air leaks into negative-pressure ducts.

blocks.zh: 數值規格速查 Specifications Quick Reference
blocks.en: Specifications Quick Reference

blocks.zh:
危險物質排氣風管：洩漏率 = 0%（基本上零洩漏）
產品加工區域：洩漏率 ≤ 1%
一般區域：依能耗經濟分析決定

施工完成後吹掃：≥ 1 小時
測試儀器：可追溯校正
文件：簽章核准
blocks.en:
Hazardous material exhaust ductwork: leakage rate = 0% (essentially zero leakage)
Product processing areas: leakage rate ≤ 1%
General areas: determined by energy economic analysis

Blow-down after construction: ≥ 1 hour
Test instruments: traceable calibration
Documentation: signed and approved

blocks.zh: 重點提示：吹掃 ≠ 清潔
blocks.en: Key Point: Blow-down ≠ Cleaning

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別指出：吹掃（blow down）只能清除鬆散的輕質碎屑，無法清除因為施工不當留下的金屬碎片。這句話的弦外之音是：不要指望靠吹掃來彌補 build clean 的不足。潔淨施工是根本，吹掃只是補充。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically notes that blowing down the duct removes only loose, light debris and cannot remove metal fragments left by poor construction practice. The implication is: do not expect blow-down to make up for shortcomings in build clean. Build clean is the foundation; blow-down is only a supplement.

blocks.zh: 5.3.9 - 5.3.15 Dampers, Diffusers, UV Lights, Exhaust, UDAF, Controls & Building（其他安裝項目）
blocks.en: 5.3.9 - 5.3.15 Dampers, Diffusers, UV Lights, Exhaust, UDAF, Controls & Building

blocks.zh: 核心概念：UDAF 驗證要點
blocks.en: Key Concept: Key Points for UDAF Verification

blocks.zh: UDAF（Unidirectional Airflow，單向氣流罩）：Grade A/ISO 5 區域的核心設備。驗證要點：
blocks.en: UDAF (Unidirectional Airflow): The core equipment of Grade A/ISO 5 areas. Key verification points:

blocks.zh: 面速度測量位置：距濾網面 15~30 cm，不是在工作面上
blocks.en: Face velocity measurement location: 15-30 cm from the filter face, not at the working surface.

blocks.zh: 均勻度標準：各測量點速度與目標值偏差 ≤ 20%
blocks.en: Uniformity criterion: The velocity at each measurement point deviates from the target value by ≤ 20%.

blocks.zh: 氣流可視化：靜態（無操作員、設備不運轉）條件下觀察氣流型態
blocks.en: Airflow visualization: Observe the airflow pattern under at-rest conditions (no operators, equipment not running).

blocks.zh: 最佳速度不一定是 0.45 m/s：可以測試不同速度下的氣流型態，找到最佳平衡點
blocks.en: The optimal velocity is not necessarily 0.45 m/s: Airflow patterns can be tested at different velocities to find the best balance.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：亂流與距離的關係
blocks.en: Analogy: Turbulence and Distance

blocks.zh: 就像淋浴的水柱——靠近蓮蓬頭時水流整齊筆直，但離蓮蓬頭越遠，水柱就越散亂。UDAF 的氣流也是如此：離 HEPA 濾網越近越層流，越遠越紊流。所以 ISPE 建議在調試階段使用臨時簾幕和空氣動力學擋板來改善關鍵區域的氣流型態——就像在淋浴間加裝擋板來導引水流一樣。
blocks.en: It is like a shower: close to the shower head the water stream is neat and straight, but the farther away you get, the more scattered it becomes. UDAF airflow behaves the same way: the closer to the HEPA filter, the more laminar it is, and the farther away, the more turbulent. That is why ISPE recommends using temporary curtains and aerodynamic baffles during commissioning to improve the airflow pattern in critical areas, much like adding a panel in a shower stall to guide the water.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：UV 燈的隱藏風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Hidden Risks of UV Lights

blocks.zh: UV 燈會降解塑膠材料——包括濾網濾材和邊框、電線外皮、墊片、風管保溫材。安裝時必須確保這些材料距離 UV 光源至少 1 公尺。另外，手指油脂會永久蝕刻 UV 燈管玻璃，必須戴手套操作。
blocks.en: UV lights degrade plastic materials, including filter media and frames, wire insulation, gaskets and duct insulation. During installation, make sure these materials are at least 1 meter from the UV source. In addition, finger grease permanently etches the glass of UV lamps, so gloves must be worn when handling them.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：建築密封性的「七大漏洞」
blocks.en: Key Point: The "Seven Leaks" of Building Tightness

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出了壓差失控最常見的滲漏源：
blocks.en: ISPE lists the most common leakage sources behind loss of pressure differential control:

blocks.zh: 管道穿牆處
blocks.en: Pipe penetrations through walls

blocks.zh: 風管穿牆處
blocks.en: Duct penetrations through walls

blocks.zh: 電線導管和插座
blocks.en: Electrical conduits and outlets

blocks.zh: 門縫
blocks.en: Door gaps

blocks.zh: 出風口和回風口
blocks.en: Supply and return air openings

blocks.zh: 牆壁和天花板接縫
blocks.en: Wall and ceiling joints

blocks.zh: 燈具
blocks.en: Light fixtures

blocks.zh: 這些都是施工期間必須逐一檢查、密封的位置。遺漏任何一個都可能導致壓差控制不達標，延遲確效進度。
blocks.en: Each of these locations must be checked and sealed during construction. Missing any one of them can cause pressure control to fall short of requirements and delay qualification.

blocks.zh: 你的 UDAF 面速度均勻度是否在 ±20% 以內？是否做過靜態氣流可視化測試？
blocks.en: Is your UDAF face velocity uniformity within ±20%? Has static airflow visualization testing been performed?

blocks.zh: 施工期間是否有專人負責檢查穿牆管線的密封狀態？
blocks.en: During construction, is a dedicated person responsible for checking the sealing of wall penetrations?

blocks.zh: 潔淨區施工人員是否穿著指定的防護服（鞋套、工作服）？
blocks.en: Do construction workers in cleanroom areas wear the designated protective clothing (shoe covers, coveralls)?

blocks.zh: 5.4 Commissioning and Qualification（調試與確效）
blocks.en: 5.4 Commissioning and Qualification

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Commissioning vs Qualification 的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Key Difference between Commissioning and Qualification

blocks.zh: 這是 HVAC 確效中最重要的概念區分：
blocks.en: This is the most important conceptual distinction in HVAC qualification:

blocks.zh: Commissioning（調試）：GEP（Good Engineering Practice）的範疇，驗證系統「按設計運作」。所有系統都應該做。屬於工程層面的驗證。
blocks.en: Commissioning: Falls under GEP (Good Engineering Practice) and verifies that the system "operates as designed". It should be done for all systems. It is verification at the engineering level.

blocks.zh: Qualification（確效）：GMP 的範疇，驗證系統對產品品質有「直接影響」的關鍵組件。只有 direct impact 系統才需要。屬於品質層面的驗證。
blocks.en: Qualification: Falls under GMP and verifies the critical components of systems that have a "direct impact" on product quality. It is required only for direct impact systems. It is verification at the quality level.

blocks.zh: 兩者的交叉點是 air balancing——它同時出現在 commissioning 和 qualification 清單中，因為它既是工程調整也是品質驗證。
blocks.en: The point where the two intersect is air balancing: it appears on both the commissioning and the qualification lists, because it is both an engineering adjustment and a quality verification.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Impact Assessment（影響評估）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Impact Assessment

blocks.zh: ISPE 的系統分類框架：
blocks.en: ISPE's system classification framework:

blocks.zh: Direct Impact（直接影響）：對產品品質有直接影響 → 必須 Qualify。例如：HEPA 濾網、壓差監控、溫度監控
blocks.en: Direct Impact: Direct effect on product quality, so it must be qualified. Examples: HEPA filters, pressure differential monitoring, temperature monitoring.

blocks.zh: Indirect Impact（間接影響）：支持直接影響系統 → Commissioning 即可。例如：AHU 本體、預過濾器
blocks.en: Indirect Impact: Supports direct impact systems, so commissioning is sufficient. Examples: the AHU itself, pre-filters.

blocks.zh: No Impact（無影響）：與產品品質無關 → 基本 Commissioning。例如：辦公區 HVAC
blocks.en: No Impact: Unrelated to product quality, so basic commissioning only. Example: HVAC for office areas.

blocks.zh: ISPE 提供了一個巧妙的「系統邊界」思維：可以把所有終端 HEPA 濾網定義為「空氣品質系統」，畫出一個 direct impact 的邊界，而把 AHU 和預濾器歸類為 indirect impact。這樣確效文件就能聚焦在風險最高的組件上。
blocks.en: ISPE offers a clever "system boundary" approach: all terminal HEPA filters can be defined as an "air quality system" with a direct impact boundary drawn around it, while the AHU and pre-filters are classified as indirect impact. This lets the qualification documentation focus on the highest-risk components.

blocks.zh: 想像一家餐廳的衛生檢查：「Commissioning」就像檢查廚房設備都能正常運作（爐子會點火、冰箱會製冷、抽油煙機會排氣）。「Qualification」則是檢查那些直接接觸食物的設備是否滿足食品安全標準（砧板消毒、冷藏溫度、烹飪溫度）。不是所有設備都需要食安檢查，但直接接觸食物的設備必須通過。
blocks.en: Think of a restaurant hygiene inspection: "commissioning" is like checking that the kitchen equipment works properly (the stove lights, the refrigerator cools, the exhaust hood extracts). "Qualification" is checking that the equipment that directly contacts food meets food safety standards (cutting board sanitization, refrigeration temperature, cooking temperature). Not every piece of equipment needs a food safety inspection, but equipment that directly contacts food must pass.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，Impact Assessment 的結果會直接影響變更控制（Change Control）的範圍和力度。正確的系統分類可以：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the outcome of the impact assessment directly affects the scope and rigor of change control. Correct system classification can:

blocks.zh: 減少確效文件量：只有 direct impact 組件需要正式的 IQ/OQ/PQ
blocks.en: Reduce qualification documentation: Only direct impact components need formal IQ/OQ/PQ.

blocks.zh: 加速變更審批：indirect impact 組件的更換不需要重新確效
blocks.en: Speed up change approval: Replacing indirect impact components does not require requalification.

blocks.zh: 聚焦資源：把有限的 QA 資源集中在真正影響產品品質的地方
blocks.en: Focus resources: Concentrate limited QA resources where product quality is truly affected.

blocks.zh: 5.4.1.1 - 5.4.1.4 Room Testing（房間測試）
blocks.en: 5.4.1.1 - 5.4.1.4 Room Testing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：壓差報警延遲測試
blocks.en: Key Concept: Pressure Alarm Delay Test

blocks.zh: 這是一個非常實用且經常被忽略的測試。當兩個不同潔淨等級的房間之間沒有氣鎖（airlock）時，開門會瞬間破壞壓差。壓差報警如果設定太靈敏，操作人員每次開門都會觸發報警（假報警太多）；設定太遲鈍，真正的壓差異常又來不及發現。
blocks.en: This is a very practical test that is often overlooked. When there is no airlock between two rooms of different cleanliness grades, opening the door instantly disrupts the pressure differential. If the pressure alarm is set too sensitive, operators trigger an alarm every time they open the door (too many false alarms); if it is set too sluggish, a genuine pressure abnormality may not be detected in time.

blocks.zh: ISPE 的方法：用實驗測量「開門後多久粒子會超標」，然後把報警延遲設定在這個時間的 50% 以下。這樣既不會有太多假報警，也能在真正異常時及時警告。
blocks.en: ISPE's approach: Measure experimentally how long it takes for particle counts to exceed limits after the door is opened, then set the alarm delay at no more than 50% of that time. This avoids too many false alarms while still giving a timely warning when something is genuinely wrong.

blocks.zh: 就像設定汽車超速警報：如果你在高速公路上偶爾超速 1~2 秒就響鈴，司機會很煩然後把它關掉。但如果設定在「超速超過 5 秒才響」，就能區分「偶爾加速超車」和「持續超速」。壓差報警延遲的邏輯完全相同——給正常操作（開門走動）留出時間窗口，但對真正的異常要快速反應。
blocks.en: It is like setting a speeding alarm in a car: if it sounded every time you briefly exceeded the limit by 1-2 seconds on the highway, the driver would get annoyed and switch it off. But if it is set to sound only after "speeding for more than 5 seconds", it can distinguish "a brief acceleration to overtake" from "sustained speeding". The logic of the pressure alarm delay is exactly the same: allow a time window for normal operations (opening doors, walking through), but respond quickly to genuine abnormalities.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：測試方法的精妙設計
blocks.en: Key Point: The Clever Design of the Test Method

blocks.zh: 注意這個測試設計的巧思：
blocks.en: Note the thought behind this test design:

blocks.zh: 先把低潔淨區的粒子抬到「上限」——模擬最惡劣的情境
blocks.en: First raise the particle level in the lower-grade area to its "upper limit" to simulate the worst-case scenario.

blocks.zh: 粒子計數器放在「門和關鍵區域之間」——監測的是粒子入侵的「路徑」
blocks.en: Place the particle counter "between the door and the critical area", so that it monitors the "path" of particle ingress.

blocks.zh: 如果關鍵區域在 UDAF 下面，計數器要遠離——因為 UDAF 會干擾結果
blocks.en: If the critical area is under a UDAF, keep the counter away from it, because the UDAF would interfere with the result.

blocks.zh: 延遲設定在測量值的 50% 以下——留有充足的安全裕度
blocks.en: Set the delay at no more than 50% of the measured value, leaving an ample safety margin.

blocks.zh: 5.5 Training（培訓）
blocks.en: 5.5 Training

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 培訓的「Why-How-What」架構
blocks.en: Key Concept: The "Why-How-What" Structure of HVAC Training

blocks.zh: ISPE 的培訓內容架構完全符合黃金圈法則（Golden Circle）：
blocks.en: ISPE's training content structure fully matches the Golden Circle approach:

blocks.zh: Why（為什麼）：HVAC 系統對產品和病人的影響——讓維護人員理解自己工作的意義
blocks.en: Why: The impact of the HVAC system on the product and the patient, so that maintenance staff understand the meaning of their work.

blocks.zh: How（如何做）：系統如何維持 User Requirements——理解原理才能做對的事
blocks.en: How: How the system maintains the User Requirements; understanding the principles is what allows people to do the right thing.

blocks.zh: What（做什麼）：具體的 SOP、校正程序、紀錄保存——日常執行的細節
blocks.en: What: The specific SOPs, calibration procedures and record retention, which are the details of day-to-day execution.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：變更控制的範圍
blocks.en: Key Point: Scope of Change Control

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調：納入變更控制的組件要「盡可能少」（as few as possible），基於關鍵性（criticality）判斷。這與前面 Impact Assessment 的邏輯一致——不是所有 HVAC 組件都需要變更控制，只有 direct impact 的關鍵組件才需要。這是風險導向思維在培訓內容中的體現。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically emphasizes that the components placed under change control should be "as few as possible", based on a judgment of criticality. This is consistent with the logic of the impact assessment above: not every HVAC component needs change control, only critical components with a direct impact. It reflects risk-based thinking in the training content.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，HVAC 維護人員的培訓尤其重要，因為：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, training of HVAC maintenance personnel is especially important because:

blocks.zh: 不同客戶產品可能有不同的環境要求（溫濕度、壓差、換氣次數）
blocks.en: Different clients' products may have different environmental requirements (temperature, humidity, pressure differential, air change rate)

blocks.zh: 產品轉換時 HVAC 參數可能需要調整
blocks.en: HVAC parameters may need to be adjusted at product changeover

blocks.zh: 維護人員需要理解「為什麼這些參數很重要」而非只是「照表操課」
blocks.en: Maintenance staff need to understand "why these parameters matter" rather than just "following the checklist"

blocks.zh: 培訓記錄是 GMP 稽查的必查項目
blocks.en: Training records are always examined in GMP inspections

blocks.zh: 5.6 Equipment Operation and Maintenance（設備運轉與維護保養）
blocks.en: 5.6 Equipment Operation and Maintenance

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PM vs PdM 維護策略
blocks.en: Key Concept: PM vs PdM Maintenance Strategies

blocks.zh: 兩種維護策略的本質差異：
blocks.en: The essential difference between the two maintenance strategies:

blocks.zh: PM（Preventive Maintenance，預防性維護）：按時間表定期維護——「時間到了就做」，不管設備狀態如何。像定期換機油。
blocks.en: PM (Preventive Maintenance): Maintenance performed periodically on a schedule: "do it when the time comes", regardless of the condition of the equipment. Like changing engine oil at regular intervals.

blocks.zh: PdM（Predictive Maintenance，預測性維護）：基於設備狀態監測（振動、溫度、磨損指標）決定何時維護——「快壞了才做」。像根據機油分析結果決定何時換油。
blocks.en: PdM (Predictive Maintenance): Maintenance timing is decided from equipment condition monitoring (vibration, temperature, wear indicators): "do it when it is about to fail". Like deciding when to change the oil based on oil analysis results.

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出 PM 的局限：無法提前發現許多機械故障。PdM 的優勢在於可以：提前訂購零件、安排人力、在計畫停機期間合併修繕。
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly points out the limitation of PM: it cannot detect many mechanical failures in advance. The advantage of PdM is that it allows you to order parts ahead of time, arrange manpower, and combine repairs into planned shutdowns.

blocks.zh: PM 就像每 5,000 公里換一次機油，不管油的品質如何。PdM 就像用油品分析儀檢測機油劣化程度，在油真正開始失效前才換。PM 可能換太早（浪費）或太晚（損壞），PdM 則精準打擊「最佳更換時機」。在 HVAC 系統中，振動分析就是最好的 PdM 工具——它能提前數週甚至數月預測軸承故障。
blocks.en: PM is like changing the oil every 5,000 km regardless of its quality. PdM is like using an oil analyzer to measure how degraded the oil is and changing it just before it actually starts to fail. PM may replace too early (wasteful) or too late (damage), while PdM pinpoints the "optimal replacement time". In HVAC systems, vibration analysis is the best PdM tool: it can predict bearing failure weeks or even months ahead.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：外觀即品質
blocks.en: Key Point: Appearance Reflects Quality

blocks.zh: ISPE 提出了一個很有深度的觀點：「設備的外觀反映維護的品質」。即使重新刷漆不會改善 HVAC 性能，但它傳達了「我們重視這個系統」的訊息。在 FDA 稽查時，機房裡的廢棄物料、多餘零件和垃圾會讓稽查官對整個維護程式的品質產生質疑。外觀管理是 cGMP 稽查的隱形加分項。
blocks.en: ISPE makes a thoughtful point: "the appearance of the equipment reflects the quality of maintenance". Even though repainting does not improve HVAC performance, it conveys the message "we value this system". During an FDA inspection, scrap material, surplus parts and rubbish in the mechanical room make the inspector doubt the quality of the whole maintenance program. Good housekeeping is a hidden plus in a cGMP inspection.

blocks.zh: 5.6.2 - 5.6.5 AHU, Fans, Coils & Humidifiers Maintenance（AHU、風扇、盤管與加濕器維護）
blocks.en: 5.6.2 - 5.6.5 AHU, Fans, Coils & Humidifiers Maintenance

blocks.zh: 重點提示：AHU 維護的微生物風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Microbial Risk in AHU Maintenance

blocks.zh: AHU 內部的微生物風險來源：
blocks.en: Sources of microbial risk inside an AHU:

blocks.zh: 積灰 + 濕度 = 微生物溫床：預濾器無法攔截所有灰塵，AHU 內部逐漸積灰，加上盤管和加濕器附近的濕度，形成微生物生長的完美條件
blocks.en: Dust + humidity = microbial breeding ground: Pre-filters cannot capture all dust, so dust gradually accumulates inside the AHU; together with the humidity near the coils and humidifiers, this creates ideal conditions for microbial growth.

blocks.zh: 凝結水積水：排水盤中的積水是最常見的微生物來源。台灣夏季高溫高濕期間要特別注意排水狀況
blocks.en: Standing condensate: Water standing in the drain pan is the most common microbial source. Pay particular attention to drainage during Taiwan's hot and humid summer.

blocks.zh: 保溫材破損：外部保溫的蒸氣屏障破損會導致保溫內部凝結，促進黴菌和細菌生長
blocks.en: Damaged insulation: A damaged vapor barrier on external insulation causes condensation inside the insulation, promoting mold and bacterial growth.

blocks.zh: 對策：用殺菌溶液定期清洗 AHU 內部，同時去除油脂。除銹後重新上漆。
blocks.en: Countermeasure: Periodically clean the inside of the AHU with a germicidal solution, removing grease at the same time. Repaint after removing rust.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風扇維護的「五感法則」
blocks.en: Key Concept: The "Five Senses" Rule for Fan Maintenance

blocks.zh: ISPE 描述的風扇維護本質上是一種「五感」檢查法：
blocks.en: Fan maintenance as described by ISPE is essentially a "five senses" inspection method:

blocks.zh: 看（Look）：檢查皮帶磨損、葉輪積灰、腐蝕跡象
blocks.en: Look: Check for belt wear, dust buildup on the impeller and signs of corrosion.

blocks.zh: 聽（Listen）：異常噪音可能預示軸承故障或不平衡
blocks.en: Listen: Abnormal noise may indicate bearing failure or imbalance.

blocks.zh: 摸（Feel）：馬達和軸承的過熱或異常振動
blocks.en: Feel: Overheating or abnormal vibration of the motor and bearings.

blocks.zh: 量（Measure）：皮帶張力（用張力計或音波張力計）、振動值
blocks.en: Measure: Belt tension (using a tension gauge or sonic tension meter) and vibration values.

blocks.zh: 算（Calculate）：馬達運轉成本分析，證明維護投資的合理性
blocks.en: Calculate: Analyze the motor running cost to justify the maintenance investment.

blocks.zh: 馬達年運轉成本計算
blocks.en: Annual Motor Running Cost Calculation

blocks.zh:
年度電費 = 馬達功率 (hp) × 8760 hr/yr × 電費單價

範例：25 hp × 8760 hr/yr × $0.075/kWh = $12,250/yr
（約 NT$390,000/年）

這代表一台 25 hp 馬達每年的電費就接近 40 萬台幣。
維護良好可延長壽命至 10 年以上，
而因維護不當導致的提前更換成本遠高於維護費用。
blocks.en:
Annual electricity cost = motor power (hp) × 8760 hr/yr × electricity unit price

Example: 25 hp × 8760 hr/yr × $0.075/kWh = $12,250/yr
(about NT$390,000/year)

This means the electricity cost of a single 25 hp motor
is close to NT$400,000 per year.
With good maintenance its life can be extended to more than 10 years,
while the cost of premature replacement due to poor maintenance
is far higher than the maintenance cost.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：V-belt 磨合程序
blocks.en: Key Point: V-belt Run-In Procedure

blocks.zh: 新皮帶必須做「磨合」（Run-In）：全負載運轉 24 小時後重新調整張力。新皮帶會伸長，如果不重新張力調整：
blocks.en: New belts must be "run in": readjust the tension after 24 hours of full-load operation. New belts stretch, and if the tension is not readjusted:

blocks.zh: 皮帶打滑 → 風量降低
blocks.en: The belt slips → airflow decreases

blocks.zh: 打滑產熱 → 皮帶加速老化
blocks.en: Slipping generates heat → the belt ages faster

blocks.zh: 最終結果：皮帶過早斷裂、非計畫停機
blocks.en: End result: premature belt breakage and unplanned downtime

blocks.zh: 這是風扇維護中最常見的根本原因之一，卻也是最容易被忽略的步驟。
blocks.en: This is one of the most common root causes in fan maintenance, yet it is also the step most easily overlooked.

blocks.zh: 你的 AHU 內部清潔頻率是多少？是否使用殺菌溶液？
blocks.en: How often is the inside of your AHUs cleaned? Is a germicidal solution used?

blocks.zh: 軸承潤滑是否有明確的頻率和用量規範？是否曾因過度潤滑導致軸承損壞？
blocks.en: Are there clear frequency and quantity specifications for bearing lubrication? Has over-lubrication ever caused bearing damage?

blocks.zh: 皮帶更換後是否有執行 24 小時磨合和重新張力調整的程序？
blocks.en: After a belt is replaced, is there a procedure for the 24-hour run-in and tension readjustment?

blocks.zh: 5.6.6 - 5.6.9 Desiccant, Filtration, Ductwork & Dampers Maintenance（除濕器、濾網、風管與風門維護）
blocks.en: 5.6.6 - 5.6.9 Desiccant, Filtration, Ductwork & Dampers Maintenance

blocks.zh: 重點提示：乾燥劑系統故障的第一嫌疑犯——濾網堵塞
blocks.en: Key Point: The First Suspect in Desiccant System Failures Is Clogged Filters

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：「大量乾燥劑系統的問題報告都可追溯到濾網堵塞」。乾燥劑系統有兩組進氣濾網（製程側 + 再生側），任一側堵塞都會造成問題：
blocks.en: ISPE states explicitly: "a large share of reported desiccant system problems can be traced to clogged filters". A desiccant system has two sets of inlet filters (process side + regeneration side), and a clog on either side causes problems:

blocks.zh: 製程側堵塞：風量不足 → 系統過熱 + 能耗浪費
blocks.en: Process side clogged: Insufficient airflow, leading to overheating of the system and wasted energy.

blocks.zh: 再生側堵塞：無法帶走濕氣 → 除濕效能下降 → 最終因過溫保護而自動關機
blocks.en: Regeneration side clogged: Moisture cannot be carried away, dehumidification performance drops, and the system eventually shuts down automatically on over-temperature protection.

blocks.zh: 最佳實務：每次更換濾網時同時檢查皮帶張力，一石二鳥。
blocks.en: Best practice: Check the belt tension every time the filters are changed, killing two birds with one stone.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HEPA 濾網修補規則
blocks.en: Key Concept: HEPA Filter Repair Rules

blocks.zh: HEPA 濾網不是一有洩漏就必須更換，ISPE 允許修補，但有嚴格限制：
blocks.en: A HEPA filter does not have to be replaced the moment it leaks. ISPE allows repair, but with strict limits:

blocks.zh: 修補面積上限：≤ 濾網淨面積的 3~5%
blocks.en: Maximum repaired area: ≤ 3-5% of the filter's net area.

blocks.zh: 單一修補點尺寸上限：最短邊 ≤ 1.5 吋（3.8 cm）
blocks.en: Maximum size of a single repair: shortest side ≤ 1.5 inches (3.8 cm).

blocks.zh: 修補材料：FDA 21CFR 177.2600 食品級 RTV 矽膠
blocks.en: Repair material: FDA 21CFR 177.2600 food-grade RTV silicone.

blocks.zh: 不可修補的情況：矽膠凝膠與刀刃框架之間的洩漏、Grade A/5 罩式 HEPA（因為會影響氣流均勻性）
blocks.en: Cases where repair is not allowed: Leaks between the silicone gel and the knife-edge frame, and Grade A/5 hood-type HEPA filters (because repair would affect airflow uniformity).

blocks.zh: HEPA 測試頻率速查
blocks.en: HEPA Testing Frequency Quick Reference

blocks.zh:
GMP 操作：每年 1 次現場完整性測試
無菌製造：部分區域每 6 個月 1 次
ASHRAE 型濾網：每半年檢查 1 次，最多 2 年更換
洩漏判定：局部洩漏率 ≥ 0.01%（上游氣溶膠濃度）
blocks.en:
GMP operations: on-site integrity test once a year
Aseptic manufacturing: once every 6 months in some areas
ASHRAE-type filters: inspect every 6 months, replace within 2 years at most
Leak criterion: local leak rate ≥ 0.01% (of upstream aerosol concentration)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：HEPA 洩漏的三大來源
blocks.en: Key Point: The Three Main Sources of HEPA Leaks

blocks.zh: 濾材損傷：粗暴搬運、工具或手碰觸造成的破洞
blocks.en: Media damage: Holes caused by rough handling or contact with tools or hands.

blocks.zh: 濾材與邊框的密封處：黏膠裂開或與邊框脫離（通常是品管不良或黏膠與氣流中化學物質不相容）
blocks.en: Seal between media and frame: The adhesive cracks or separates from the frame (usually due to poor quality control, or adhesive incompatibility with chemicals in the airstream).

blocks.zh: 矽膠凝膠密封處：濾網外殼與刀刃框架之間的矽膠凝膠，因長期暴露於測試氣溶膠而劣化
blocks.en: Silicone gel seal: The silicone gel between the filter housing and the knife-edge frame degrades from long-term exposure to the test aerosol.

blocks.zh: 第三種來源特別值得注意：用來「測試」濾網的氣溶膠，反而會加速密封材料的老化。這是一個諷刺但真實的問題。
blocks.en: The third source deserves particular attention: the aerosol used to "test" the filter actually accelerates the aging of the sealing material. It is an ironic but real problem.

blocks.zh: 你的 HEPA 濾網是否有個別追蹤紀錄（序號、出廠測試數據、安裝日期）？
blocks.en: Do your HEPA filters have individual tracking records (serial number, factory test data, installation date)?

blocks.zh: 是否曾修補過 HEPA 濾網？修補面積是否符合 3~5% 的規範？
blocks.en: Have HEPA filters ever been repaired? Does the repaired area comply with the 3-5% limit?

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑系統的濾網更換頻率是否足夠？是否有因濾網堵塞導致停機的經驗？
blocks.en: Is the filter replacement frequency for desiccant systems sufficient? Have you ever had a shutdown caused by clogged filters?

blocks.zh: 5.6.10 - 5.6.14 Other Equipment Maintenance & Air Balancing（其他設備維護與風量平衡）
blocks.en: 5.6.10 - 5.6.14 Other Equipment Maintenance & Air Balancing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TAB（風量平衡）的風險與頻率
blocks.en: Key Concept: Risk and Frequency of TAB (Air Balancing)

blocks.zh: TAB（Testing, Adjusting, and Balancing）：風量平衡不是一次性的工作，是需要定期重做的循環作業。ISPE 提出的關鍵洞見：
blocks.en: TAB (Testing, Adjusting, and Balancing): Air balancing is not a one-time job but a cycle that must be repeated periodically. Key insights from ISPE:

blocks.zh: 局部調整的蝴蝶效應：增加一個房間的風量，可能會減少所有其他房間的風量。這就像一根水管分出多個支管——打開一個閥門，其他支管的水壓都會降低
blocks.en: Butterfly effect of local adjustment: Increasing the airflow to one room may reduce the airflow to all other rooms. It is like a water pipe with several branches: open one valve and the water pressure in the other branches drops.

blocks.zh: 建築老化效應：隨著建築老化，穿牆管線密封處逐漸劣化，漏氣增加，壓差關係失控
blocks.en: Building aging effect: As the building ages, the seals around wall penetrations gradually deteriorate, leakage increases and the pressure relationships go out of control.

blocks.zh: 測量精度 ±10%：不要過度追求完美數字，只要房間條件（粒子、壓差、溫濕度）和恢復性能達標即可
blocks.en: Measurement accuracy ±10%: Do not over-pursue perfect numbers; it is enough that the room conditions (particles, pressure differential, temperature and humidity) and recovery performance meet requirements.

blocks.zh: 維護頻率速查表
blocks.en: Maintenance Frequency Quick Reference

blocks.zh:
無菌操作（Grade 5-7）：
  儀器校正 + ACPH 確認 + HEPA 測試 = 每 6 個月

GMP 潔淨操作（Grade 8）：
  儀器校正 + ACPH 確認 + HEPA 測試 = 每 1 年

其他 GMP 空間（中試、動物房、實驗室）：
  完整風量再平衡 = 每 5 年

非 GMP 空間（機房、辦公室）：
  完整風量再平衡 = 每 7 年

風量測量罩校正：每年 1 次
blocks.en:
Aseptic operations (Grade 5-7):
  Instrument calibration + ACPH confirmation + HEPA testing = every 6 months

GMP clean operations (Grade 8):
  Instrument calibration + ACPH confirmation + HEPA testing = every 1 year

Other GMP spaces (pilot plant, animal facility, laboratory):
  Full air rebalancing = every 5 years

Non-GMP spaces (mechanical rooms, offices):
  Full air rebalancing = every 7 years

Airflow capture hood calibration: once a year

blocks.zh: 重點提示：UV 燈的維護陷阱
blocks.en: Key Point: UV Lamp Maintenance Pitfalls

blocks.zh: UV 燈泡壽命約 8,000 小時（約 11 個月連續運轉）。但壽命會因積灰和指紋而縮短。很多工廠只在燈泡不亮時才更換，卻忽略了：即使燈泡還亮，UV 強度可能已經降到無法有效殺菌的水平。建議搭配 UV 強度計定期測量，而非只看「亮不亮」。
blocks.en: A UV lamp lasts about 8,000 hours (about 11 months of continuous operation), but its life is shortened by dust buildup and fingerprints. Many facilities replace a lamp only when it stops lighting, overlooking the fact that even while the lamp is still lit, its UV intensity may have dropped below the level needed for effective germicidal action. It is recommended to measure periodically with a UV intensity meter rather than just checking whether the lamp is "on".

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，風量平衡的挑戰尤其大：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, air balancing is especially challenging:

blocks.zh: 房間用途變更：不同客戶產品可能需要不同的換氣次數和壓差
blocks.en: Change of room use: Different clients' products may need different air change rates and pressure differentials.

blocks.zh: 產能擴張：加裝新設備可能改變房間的熱負荷和送風需求
blocks.en: Capacity expansion: Adding new equipment may change a room's heat load and supply air requirements.

blocks.zh: 局部調整的連鎖反應：為一條新產線調整風量，可能影響同一 AHU 服務的所有其他房間
blocks.en: Knock-on effects of local adjustment: Adjusting airflow for a new production line may affect all other rooms served by the same AHU.

blocks.zh: 建議：任何涉及風量變更的改動，都要做全系統 TAB，不要只做局部調整。
blocks.en: Recommendation: any change involving airflow should be followed by a full-system TAB, not just a local adjustment.

blocks.zh: 5.7 Spare Parts（備品管理）
blocks.en: 5.7 Spare Parts

blocks.zh: 核心概念：備品策略的「關鍵五項」
blocks.en: Key Concept: The "Critical Five" Spare Parts Strategy

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出的五項關鍵備品反映了 HVAC 系統最脆弱的環節：
blocks.en: The five critical spares listed by ISPE reflect the most vulnerable points of an HVAC system:

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑輪：閒置後可能失效，尤其是 LiCl 輪。備用一組可以在第一個潮濕日立即替換
blocks.en: Desiccant wheel: May fail after sitting idle, especially LiCl wheels. Having a spare set ready allows immediate replacement on the first humid day.

blocks.zh: 感測器/傳送器：利用「規格統一化」策略，相同規格的感測器只需備一個——這是備品管理的智慧
blocks.en: Sensors/transmitters: Using a "specification standardization" strategy, only one spare is needed for sensors of the same specification, which is smart spare parts management.

blocks.zh: 終端 HEPA 濾網：最可能被「清潔過度」損壞的組件。UFH 的 HEPA 撕裂會直接影響 Grade A 區
blocks.en: Terminal HEPA filters: The components most likely to be damaged by "over-cleaning". A HEPA tear in a UFH directly affects the Grade A area.

blocks.zh: 高溫 HEPA 濾網：除熱原隧道用，可能需要整批同時更換，無法修補。交期長，必須提前備貨
blocks.en: High-temperature HEPA filters: Used for depyrogenation tunnels; the whole set may need to be replaced at once and cannot be repaired. Lead times are long, so stock must be prepared in advance.

blocks.zh: 風扇皮帶：成本低、更換頻繁、定期檢查可預測更換時機
blocks.en: Fan belts: Low cost, replaced frequently, and the replacement timing is predictable through regular inspection.

blocks.zh: 備品管理就像家裡的急救箱——你不需要儲備所有藥品，只需要備好最可能用到的：OK 繃（風扇皮帶）、退燒藥（感測器）、紗布（HEPA 濾網）。關鍵是根據「故障風險」和「停機影響」來決定備什麼、備多少。高溫 HEPA 濾網就像特殊處方藥——不常用，但一旦需要就非常緊急，而且不能臨時配藥。
blocks.en: Spare parts management is like a home first-aid kit: you do not need to stock every medicine, only those you are most likely to use: adhesive bandages (fan belts), fever reducers (sensors), gauze (HEPA filters). The key is to decide what to stock and how much based on "failure risk" and "downtime impact". High-temperature HEPA filters are like a special prescription drug: rarely used, but extremely urgent when needed, and it cannot be compounded on the spot.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：HEPA 濾網的「過度清潔」風險
blocks.en: Key Point: The Risk of "Over-Cleaning" HEPA Filters

blocks.zh: ISPE 用了「over-zealous cleaning（過度熱心的清潔）」這個詞——這在潔淨室環境中是一個反直覺的風險。清潔人員為了確保潔淨度，可能過度用力擦拭暴露在房間中的 HEPA 濾網面，導致濾材撕裂。這提醒我們：清潔 SOP 必須明確規定 HEPA 濾網的清潔方式和限制。
blocks.en: ISPE uses the term "over-zealous cleaning", which is a counterintuitive risk in a cleanroom environment. To ensure cleanliness, cleaning staff may wipe the HEPA filter face exposed in the room too forcefully and tear the media. This is a reminder that cleaning SOPs must clearly specify how HEPA filters are to be cleaned, and the limits.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的備品策略需要考慮的額外因素：
blocks.en: Additional factors a CDMO's spare parts strategy needs to consider:

blocks.zh: 多產品共線：不同產品可能需要不同規格的 HEPA 濾網或特殊感測器
blocks.en: Multi-product shared lines: Different products may need HEPA filters of different specifications or special sensors.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈風險：高溫 HEPA 濾網的供應商通常很少，交期可能長達 3~6 個月
blocks.en: Supply chain risk: There are usually few suppliers of high-temperature HEPA filters, and lead times can be as long as 3-6 months.

blocks.zh: 成本效益分析：備品庫存成本 vs 停機損失。一天的生產停機可能比整年的備品庫存成本更高
blocks.en: Cost-benefit analysis: Spare parts inventory cost vs downtime loss. One day of production downtime can cost more than a whole year of spare parts inventory.

blocks.zh: 規格統一化：在新廠設計階段就統一感測器規格，可以大幅減少備品種類和數量
blocks.en: Specification standardization: Standardizing sensor specifications at the new facility design stage can greatly reduce the variety and quantity of spares.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠是否有 HVAC 備品清單？是否涵蓋 ISPE 建議的五項關鍵備品？
blocks.en: Does your facility have an HVAC spare parts list? Does it cover the five critical spares recommended by ISPE?

blocks.zh: 高溫 HEPA 濾網的備品數量是否足以一次更換整個除熱原隧道的濾網組？
blocks.en: Is the quantity of spare high-temperature HEPA filters sufficient to replace the whole filter set of a depyrogenation tunnel at once?

blocks.zh: 感測器規格是否已經統一化？如果現有系統使用多種規格，未來改造時是否計畫統一？
blocks.en: Have sensor specifications been standardized? If the existing system uses several specifications, is there a plan to standardize them in future modifications?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 潔淨施工（Build Clean）是基礎：安裝前清潔、安裝後密封、使用 zip screws 而非 self-drilling screws。施工期間的金屬碎屑是 HEPA 完整性失敗的主要原因之一
blocks.en: Build clean is the foundation: Clean before installation, seal after installation, and use zip screws rather than self-drilling screws. Metal debris from construction is one of the main causes of HEPA integrity failures.

blocks.zh: AHU 安裝五要點：正確吊裝、水平基座、P-trap 高度、RTV 密封、VFD 慢速啟動。閒置超過一個月的設備需每兩週轉動軸承
blocks.en: Five key points of AHU installation: Correct lifting, level foundation, P-trap height, RTV sealing, slow VFD startup. Equipment idle for more than a month needs its bearings rotated every two weeks.

blocks.zh: 風扇安裝是高風險作業：雷射對中、皮帶張力、點動測試、振動測試，每一步都攸關安全和系統壽命
blocks.en: Fan installation is a high-risk operation: Laser alignment, belt tension, bump test and vibration test; every step affects safety and system life.

blocks.zh: Commissioning vs Qualification：Commissioning = GEP（所有系統都做）；Qualification = GMP（只有 direct impact 系統才需要）。Impact Assessment 決定確效範圍
blocks.en: Commissioning vs Qualification: Commissioning = GEP (done for all systems); Qualification = GMP (only for direct impact systems). The impact assessment determines the scope of qualification.

blocks.zh: 壓差報警延遲測試：實驗測量「開門後粒子超標時間」，報警延遲設定在 50% 以下
blocks.en: Pressure alarm delay test: Measure experimentally the time for particles to exceed limits after the door is opened, and set the alarm delay at no more than 50% of it.

blocks.zh: PdM 優於 PM：振動和溫度監測可提前預測軸承故障。外觀整潔也是 GMP 合規的隱形指標
blocks.en: PdM is better than PM: Vibration and temperature monitoring can predict bearing failure in advance. A tidy appearance is also a hidden indicator of GMP compliance.

blocks.zh: HEPA 維護關鍵數字：洩漏判定 ≥ 0.01%、修補面積 ≤ 3~5%、單一修補 ≤ 1.5 吋。GMP 年測一次、無菌區半年一次
blocks.en: Key HEPA maintenance numbers: Leak criterion ≥ 0.01%, repaired area ≤ 3-5%, single repair ≤ 1.5 inches. Test once a year for GMP, every 6 months for aseptic areas.

blocks.zh: TAB 風量平衡的蝴蝶效應：局部調整影響全系統。無菌區每 6 個月、Grade 8 每年、其他 GMP 每 5 年、非 GMP 每 7 年做完整再平衡
blocks.en: The butterfly effect of TAB air balancing: A local adjustment affects the whole system. Full rebalancing every 6 months for aseptic areas, every year for Grade 8, every 5 years for other GMP areas and every 7 years for non-GMP areas.

blocks.zh: 備品五項必備：乾燥劑輪、統一規格感測器、終端 HEPA、高溫 HEPA（整批備貨）、風扇皮帶
blocks.en: Five must-have spares: Desiccant wheel, standardized sensors, terminal HEPA, high-temperature HEPA (stock the whole set), fan belts.

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑系統故障主因是濾網堵塞：兩組進氣濾網（製程側 + 再生側）都需要定期更換。LiCl 輪閒置時必須保持加熱和轉動
blocks.en: The main cause of desiccant system failure is clogged filters: Both sets of inlet filters (process side + regeneration side) need regular replacement. A LiCl wheel must be kept heated and rotating when idle.
